---
title: Add App Related Content
description: >-
  Create app related content by uploading images, drafting content details and
  choosing a content type.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Content > Add Content.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="247" height="256" style="width: 247px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Select the content category from the dropdown menu.&#x20;

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="302" height="342" style="width: 302px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Drag and drop image to add a primary visual for the content. 

- Enter title and detailed content in different language.

- Click submit to go live or save it as a draft.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="463" height="309" style="width: 463px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
